Name: Jeziel, Son of Azmaveth
Summary: Son of Azmaveth who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:3: Son of Azmaveth who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeziel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
